name: The Kitchen Index
thesis: A working photographic folio: real food, precise typography, and a clear route from collection to cooking.
distinctiveChoices: A category index alongside a generous, numbered photographic contact sheet.
Cool white, ink, and a single cobalt accent; square edges and fine rules instead of decorative cards.
Quiet per-serving price stamps, full-length titles, and in-place filters keep the imagery useful.
tradeoff: The editorial spacing favors comfortable visual browsing over maximum recipe density; filters live in an expandable panel.
